name: ni-corporate-income-tax
description: Use this skill for Nicaragua income tax on business income (IR de rentas de actividades economicas) of companies and individuals with income above C$12,000,000 for tax year 2026. It gives the 30% rate, the pago minimo definitivo of Ley 987 (3% for large taxpayers, 2% for principal taxpayers, 1% for the rest) and its exceptions (first three years with new investment, maturation periods), monthly advances, the higher of IR or PMD, the 2% and 10% retentions received, definitive retentions to non-residents (20%, reduced 1.5% and 3% rates) and tax havens (30%), and the annual return due by the last day of February. Trigger phrases include IR anual Nicaragua, pago minimo definitivo, anticipo IR, rentas de actividades economicas, DGI VET and Ley 822.
